description: 27 Vedic nakshatras with Vimshottari lords, deities, symbols, guna/gana, and temperament traits. Sidereal spans use Lahiri ayanamsa convention.
notes: Each nakshatra spans 13°20' (800'). Each has 4 padas of 3°20'.
Vimshottari lords cycle: Ketu, Venus, Sun, Moon, Mars, Rahu, Jupiter, Saturn, Mercury (repeat ×3).
Gana (deva/manushya/rakshasa) is temperament class used in matching; not a moral judgment.
Traits are traditional/symbolic summaries for training data — not predictive certainty.

nakshatras.name: Ashwini
nakshatras.traits: Swift, pioneering, healing impulse; quick starts and quick recoveries.
nakshatras.pada_summary: Pada1 leadership/initiative; Pada2 practical healing; Pada3 restless curiosity; Pada4 grounded service.

nakshatras.name: Bharani
nakshatras.traits: Bearing responsibility; tension between creation and limits; transformative endurance.
nakshatras.pada_summary: Pada1 creative fertility; Pada2 duty-bound restraint; Pada3 sensual intensity; Pada4 maturity through release.

nakshatras.name: Krittika
nakshatras.traits: Sharp, purifying, cutting away excess; fiery clarity and critical will.
nakshatras.pada_summary: Pada1 warrior fire; Pada2 refining craft; Pada3 harsh critique; Pada4 constructive purification.

nakshatras.name: Rohini
nakshatras.traits: Fertile, sensual, growth-oriented; Moon's favourite; attraction and abundance.
nakshatras.pada_summary: Pada1 artistic growth; Pada2 material comfort; Pada3 magnetic charm; Pada4 creative fertility.

nakshatras.name: Mrigashira
nakshatras.traits: Searching, gentle, restless; following scent of knowledge or affection.
nakshatras.pada_summary: Pada1 soft curiosity; Pada2 intellectual hunt; Pada3 communicative quest; Pada4 decisive chase.

nakshatras.name: Ardra
nakshatras.traits: Stormy, transformative; tension before renewal; emotional intensity.
nakshatras.pada_summary: Pada1 upheaval insight; Pada2 analytical storm; Pada3 communicative crisis; Pada4 regenerative release.

nakshatras.name: Punarvasu
nakshatras.traits: Return of light; renewal and safe homecoming after loss; optimistic restoration.
nakshatras.pada_summary: Pada1 hopeful restart; Pada2 nurturing return; Pada3 philosophical renewal; Pada4 protected abundance.

nakshatras.name: Pushya
nakshatras.traits: Nourishing, steady; classically among most auspicious for beginnings.
nakshatras.pada_summary: Pada1 caring structure; Pada2 disciplined nurture; Pada3 wise counsel; Pada4 lasting support.

nakshatras.name: Ashlesha
nakshatras.traits: Penetrating, hypnotic, clever; coiled intelligence and emotional entanglement.
nakshatras.pada_summary: Pada1 subtle perception; Pada2 strategic mind; Pada3 persuasive speech; Pada4 transformative wisdom.

nakshatras.name: Magha
nakshatras.traits: Regal, ancestral authority; pride and lineage consciousness.
nakshatras.pada_summary: Pada1 inherited power; Pada2 ceremonial dignity; Pada3 proud leadership; Pada4 ancestral duty.

nakshatras.name: Purva Phalguni
nakshatras.traits: Pleasure, rest, generosity; enjoyment of earned comforts.
nakshatras.pada_summary: Pada1 creative leisure; Pada2 romantic enjoyment; Pada3 social generosity; Pada4 refined pleasure.

nakshatras.name: Uttara Phalguni
nakshatras.traits: Steady partnership, kindness, contracts and patronage; keeping one's word.
nakshatras.pada_summary: Pada1 loyal alliance; Pada2 helpful service; Pada3 organized support; Pada4 lasting bonds.

nakshatras.name: Hasta
nakshatras.traits: Skilful, dexterous; ability to grasp, craft, and manifest with the hands.
nakshatras.pada_summary: Pada1 craft mastery; Pada2 practical skill; Pada3 clever manipulation; Pada4 healing touch.

nakshatras.name: Chitra
nakshatras.traits: Brilliant designer; maker of beautiful, striking forms.
nakshatras.pada_summary: Pada1 aesthetic craft; Pada2 architectural vision; Pada3 dazzling presentation; Pada4 balanced design.

nakshatras.name: Swati
nakshatras.traits: Independent, flexible, self-directed; bends without breaking.
nakshatras.pada_summary: Pada1 free spirit; Pada2 adaptable trade; Pada3 independent thought; Pada4 balanced autonomy.

nakshatras.name: Vishakha
nakshatras.traits: Goal-driven, determined, single-minded toward a fixed aim.
nakshatras.pada_summary: Pada1 ambitious drive; Pada2 focused rivalry; Pada3 transformative pursuit; Pada4 purposeful conquest.

nakshatras.name: Anuradha
nakshatras.traits: Friendship, devotion, cooperative success after struggle.
nakshatras.pada_summary: Pada1 loyal alliance; Pada2 devoted service; Pada3 structured camaraderie; Pada4 enduring bonds.

nakshatras.name: Jyeshtha
nakshatras.traits: Senior authority, protective responsibility; intensity and status consciousness.
nakshatras.pada_summary: Pada1 elder responsibility; Pada2 strategic protection; Pada3 commanding speech; Pada4 wise seniority.

nakshatras.name: Mula
nakshatras.traits: Root-seeking, investigative, dissolving foundations to find truth.
nakshatras.pada_summary: Pada1 investigative dig; Pada2 philosophical uprooting; Pada3 transformative research; Pada4 liberation via roots.

nakshatras.name: Purva Ashadha
nakshatras.traits: Invincible pride, purifying waters; early victory energy.
nakshatras.pada_summary: Pada1 early triumph; Pada2 purifying ambition; Pada3 persuasive victory; Pada4 expansive pride.

nakshatras.name: Uttara Ashadha
nakshatras.traits: Later, lasting victory; universal principles and enduring achievement.
nakshatras.pada_summary: Pada1 principled win; Pada2 disciplined success; Pada3 leadership legacy; Pada4 lasting renown.

nakshatras.name: Shravana
nakshatras.traits: Listening, learning, connecting knowledge; pilgrimage and transmission.
nakshatras.pada_summary: Pada1 attentive learning; Pada2 organized knowledge; Pada3 teaching voice; Pada4 wise listening.

nakshatras.name: Dhanishta
nakshatras.traits: Fame, rhythm, abundance through group effort; musical and material wealth.
nakshatras.pada_summary: Pada1 rhythmic drive; Pada2 collaborative wealth; Pada3 innovative fame; Pada4 structured prosperity.

nakshatras.name: Shatabhisha
nakshatras.traits: Healing mysteries, solitude, unconventional science; hundred physicians.
nakshatras.pada_summary: Pada1 mystical healing; Pada2 scientific solitude; Pada3 unconventional research; Pada4 cosmic medicine.

nakshatras.name: Purva Bhadrapada
nakshatras.traits: Intense idealism, dual-faced transformation; fire of penance.
nakshatras.pada_summary: Pada1 fierce idealism; Pada2 transformative austerity; Pada3 philosophical intensity; Pada4 sacrificial vision.

nakshatras.name: Uttara Bhadrapada
nakshatras.traits: Depth, restraint, kundalini/serpent wisdom; late, deep maturity.
nakshatras.pada_summary: Pada1 deep restraint; Pada2 occult patience; Pada3 compassionate depth; Pada4 liberation through discipline.

nakshatras.name: Revati
nakshatras.traits: Protective, nourishing journey's end; safe passage and prosperity.
nakshatras.pada_summary: Pada1 protective care; Pada2 prosperous travel; Pada3 artistic nurture; Pada4 complete fulfillment.
